title: Action
description: The domain-agnostic unit of intent submitted to the Decision OS. This is the INPUT to the kernel. A domain adapter turns a raw event (MCP tool call, robot command, transaction) into exactly this shape. Mirrors the AuthGate Action ABI v1.

actor.description: Who is acting, e.g. 'agent:support-bot'. Normalized (NFKC, control-stripped, casefolded) at the trust boundary.

action_purpose.description: WHY this call happens, e.g. 'support_reply'. Bound to the data purposes it may serve.

data_labels.description: Provenance/purpose labels of the data used in this call. Self-attached; the kernel does not trust them as ground truth without corroboration.

payload.description: Concrete arguments handed to the tool. Opaque to the contract; screened/redacted by policy.

session_id.description: Groups a multi-step trajectory for the runtime/temporal layer. Normalized like every other token, so look-alikes cannot fork a fresh session.

nonce.description: Unique per action; enables replay rejection. An empty nonce opts out of replay protection and is never recorded.

capability.description: The capability this call requests. Defaults to 'tool:<tool>' when empty.

abi_version.description: The packet ABI version. A gate speaking a different version must reject the packet.
